subject: Payment deducted but order not confirmed
description: I paid via UPI and the amount left my account, but the order page still shows pending.

messages.text: Money was deducted 20 minutes ago but no confirmation email.
Sorry about that, Nidhi. Could you share the UPI reference number?
Sure, it is 4382910023.

subject: Cannot log in after password reset
description: The reset link works but the new password is rejected on the login page.

messages.text: I reset my password twice and still cannot sign in.
Thanks. We found a stale session on your account and are clearing it now.

subject: Invoice shows the wrong company name
description: Our GST invoice lists an old company name. We need it corrected before month-end filing.

messages.text: Please reissue invoice TP26V000212 with the correct legal name.

subject: Mobile app crashes when opening the booking history screen and also drains battery quickly on Android 14 devices
description: App closes immediately on the booking history tab. Started after last week's update. Happens on a Pixel 7 running Android 14.

messages.text: The app force-closes every time I open Booking History.
We can reproduce this. Engineering is working on a fix for the next release.
Any timeline? I need my ticket details for travel.
You can view them on the web dashboard meanwhile. Fix is expected within 3 days.

subject: Request to change delivery address
description: I moved last week and need the pending order shipped to my new address.

messages.text: Can the address on order #88213 be updated?
Done. The order will now ship to your new address in Bandra.
Thank you!

subject: Refund not received after cancellation
description: Cancelled a hotel booking 10 days ago. The refund has not reached my bank account.

messages.text: It has been 10 days. Refund policy says 5-7 working days.
We have escalated this to our finance team and will update you within 24 hours.

subject: How do I add a second traveller?
description: I want to add my spouse to an existing booking but cannot find the option.

messages.text: Where can I add another passenger to my booking?
Open the booking, choose Manage passengers, then Add traveller.

subject: Discount code SAVE10 is not applying
description: The code shows as invalid at checkout even though it is valid until the end of the month.

messages.text: SAVE10 keeps giving an invalid code error.
We are checking whether the code is restricted to specific products.

subject: Passport name mismatch on e-ticket
description: My e-ticket has a misspelt surname and the airline says it must match my passport.

messages.text: Surname is spelt with a missing letter. Flight is in 5 days.
Urgent. We have requested a name correction from the airline.
Please confirm as soon as you hear back.

subject: Feature request: export bookings to CSV
description: It would help our accounts team if we could export the booking list as a CSV file.

messages.text: Please add a CSV export on the booking list page.

subject: Hotel voucher email never arrived
description: Booking is confirmed on the dashboard but the voucher was never emailed.

messages.text: I did not get a voucher email. Please resend.
Resent to your registered email. Please check spam too.
